Income Before Extraordinary Items saw an increase from 541.825 to 696.673. The most compelling metric here is the significant increase in net income from a loss of -2390.08 to an income of 696.673.

**Overall Sentiment:**

The combination of robust revenue growth, substantially improved profitability, strong liquidity position and good asset growth  leads to a very positive sentiment score.
